name: 琥珀虫巢连续整体地景 v2
collision: none; existing room collision and authored furnishings are drawn separately

palette.primary: warm cream ivory and pale honey limestone
palette.accent: tender green leaves, occasional violet pollen flowers, amber outer roots

composition: One complete horizontal 3:2 near-isometric painted landscape; continuous low-noise dry stone ground and naturally integrated hive-valley outer scenery on all four sides.

safe_margin.foreground_obstacles: No furniture or hard terrain is painted inside the mapped playable center. Small seam moss and edge flowers are nonblocking landscape detail.

notes: Confirmed against B02_gameplay_preview.png for warm bright hand-painted 2.5D rendering, camera and palette; central stone is lighter and quieter than the older saturated yellow floor.
No HUD, text, actors, enemies, pickups, beacons, nests, chests or runtime furniture are embedded in this background.
No border prefab rows, solid horizontal bands, rectangular rim, repeating tile texture or grey blank exterior.
Wider left/right middle floor passages reach the frame edges; roots, shell outcrops and large leaves remain in outer scenery.
Selected second image generation after a targeted clearance refinement. Original generated PNG copied intact; no pixel editing or rescaling.
This is a background source asset, not evidence of a completed in-game scene. Runtime integrates the complete plate and authored props separately.

placement_normalized_rect maps the authored arena to the nominal painted floor extent; walkable_normalized_polygon supplies the dry-ground boundary independently. Decorative bank props may remain outside the player boundary.
